entries.name: On Attack / On Crit / Using Ability (+ Wielding: Polearm)
On Attack / On Crit / Using Ability (+ Wielding: Heavy)

system.description:
Your wyvern easily snatches horses into its clutches. When fighting Cavalry units at 1 Rng, you gain Advantage and +5 Atk.

Only takes effect while Mounted.

Call on your wyvern to bathe all units in a forward cone in drakefire. Affected units must succeed an Agi saving throw (DC 15), or suffer 3d8 + Tqn Fire damage and 2 Brk. On a successful save, units are only dealt 1d8 + Tqn Fire damage and no Brk damage. 

Leaves behind Fire Tiles on affected squares for 1 round.

Gain another use of this ability at Level 20, and again at Level 25.

Toggle between being mounted on your wyvern or being unmounted.

While mounted in this way, this unit becomes a Flying and Dragon unit. Flying units cannot be attacked in melee, except by other Flying units. They may still be counterattacked in melee by any unit, if the Flying unit initiates the attack against them.
Exquisite plate armor, light enough to be worn without sacrificing dexterity, yet robust enough to provide heavy-duty protection.

A hefty axe, made especially for military purposes.

Polearmbreaker
